message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features an illustration of a man with brown skin and dark hair, wearing a brown collared shirt. He is submerged up to his chest inside a large, circular metal tin filled with a thick, viscous, honey-colored substance that clings to his face, hands, and clothes in long, sticky strands. His face shows a strained expression with a slight frown. His right hand rests on the tin's rim, and a gold ring is visible on his ring finger.

The tin has a red and yellow label. Large yellow cursive text on the label reads "Aib Anggaran Anies". Below this, smaller black block text states, "RANCANGAN BUJET DKI JAKARTA BERTABUR PROYEK JANGGAL. GUBERNUR ANIES BASWEDAN DITENGARAI BAKAL BAGI-BAGI DANA HIBAH BUAT PENDUKUNGNYA."

At the top, the masthead "TEMPO" is partially obscured by the man. Above it, black text reads "FAKTA BARU KEMATIAN AKTIVIS LINGKUNGAN / INVESTIGASI: KOMISI OBAT BUAT DOKTER". The bottom left corner contains a barcode and publication details: "11-17 NOVEMBER 2019", "RP 45.000", and "WWW.TEMPO.CO".
